description: Indian Navy Sea Hawk IN244, for decades on the roundabout at Mormugao/Vasco, Goa; warbirds.in notes "Update 2015: the aircraft has been moved to Raipur". The museums agent notes IN244 is claimed at both Goa and Raipur. Recorded here at Raipur per the move; needs on-site confirmation of exact location within Raipur.
